scope: Visual mockups only; no application code changes for this proposal

previews.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one polished, realistic Vietnamese iOS mobile app screen design for approval, portrait 1:2 aspect ratio, high resolution, perfectly crisp readable typography.
Reference image 1 shows the existing Asinu edit profile screen. Use it ONLY to match the app's restrained teal brand color, actual patient avatar thumbnail, and the exact field data. Completely redesign the form layout. Do not copy the old grid, boxed stats, large avatar banner or oversized gender buttons.
Primary request: a refined, familiar Facebook-style profile editor adapted to Asinu, extremely easy to read for adults including older users. The design is a clean, flat, ONE-COLUMN form, no dashboard feel.
Composition: show the full mobile SCREEN ONLY, straight on, no physical phone mockup, no perspective, no presentation board. iOS status bar at top, native home indicator at bottom.
Canvas: warm near-white with dark charcoal text and restrained Asinu teal accents. Large readable native-style sans serif with accurate Vietnamese diacritics. No decorative background illustration inside the editor. No blur, no glass, no fuzzy text.
Navigation: compact top bar, "Hủy" on the left, title "Chỉnh sửa hồ sơ" centered, teal text action "Lưu" on the right. No duplicate large save/cancel buttons at the bottom.
Below it: small circular existing avatar from the reference, about 56pt, with name "Dương Anh Đức" beside it and a simple teal "Đổi ảnh" text link. No colored banner, no card, no extra slogan.
Then group title "Thông tin cơ bản". Full-width editable field rows using whitespace and hairline separators, NEVER small rounded boxes:
"Họ tên" label above value "Dương Anh Đức".
"Số điện thoại" label above value "0338617203".
"Giới tính" on left, "Nam" with a small downward chevron on right.
Then group title "Sức khỏe".
Each of these occupies its OWN full-width horizontal row with label on left and editable number with unit on right:
"Tuổi" — "23 tuổi"
"Chiều cao" — "165 cm"
"Cân nặng" — "75 kg"
"Nhóm máu" — "O+" with a small downward chevron.
Then "Bệnh nền" with a small chevron to open selection; selected conditions wrap beneath as subtle mint selection chips: "Tiểu đường", "Cao huyết áp", "Bệnh tim mạch".
Use comfortable touch rows at least 56pt, a consistent 20pt side margin, well balanced compact spacing. Text labels at least 16pt and values 17–18pt in the visual scale. These are editable controls, with subtle underlines for typed fields and small chevrons only for pickers.
Constraints: no side-by-side fields, no four-column statistics, no raised cards, no boxed rows, no large gender tiles, no background medical icons, no extra copy, no English words, no Facebook logo. Render the listed Vietnamese text exactly and sharply, without spelling mistakes. One finished production-quality app screenshot design.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one polished realistic Vietnamese iOS personal-profile screen design for Asinu, portrait 1:2 aspect ratio, high resolution, sharp readable typography.
Input image 1 is a reference for the existing light mint healthcare BACKGROUND. Input image 2 is the exact Asinu brand mascot identity reference. Input image 3 is a reference for the existing app's profile avatar, field identity and typography; do not copy the old editor layout.
Primary request: show the PERSONAL PAGE, in a familiar Facebook-style plain accordion menu layout. Both parent group buttons AND every child action must be plain icon-plus-text rows over the same page background. Absolutely NO white card or panel behind menus, no rounded button cards, no group container card.
Background: use the soft pale mint healthcare atmosphere of reference 1 behind the entire page, with understated medical plus / stethoscope / botanical edge details. Keep the central reading area very pale and quiet. Include the friendly teal helmet-wearing mascot from reference 2 and a small clear dark-teal "ASINU" wordmark as a tasteful background signature near the bottom, away from readable controls. Do not blur any text.
Composition: mobile SCREEN ONLY, straight on, no physical phone, no perspective, no presentation board. iOS status bar on top.
At the top, one compact profile identity card may be white, matching existing Asinu: avatar from reference 3, name "Dương Anh Đức", green dot and "Đang hoạt động", small pill "Tài khoản: Free". THIS identity card is the sole white content card permitted in this image.
Below it, show these vertically stacked plain accordion header rows with appropriate small outline icons on the left, bold dark labels, chevrons on right:
"Thông tin cá nhân" collapsed, down chevron.
"Thao tác" collapsed, down chevron.
"Sức khỏe" EXPANDED, up chevron.
Under "Sức khỏe", show exactly three child action rows. IMPORTANT hierarchy: indent all child icons and labels to the RIGHT by approximately 20–24pt relative to parent icon/label positions. Every child uses the same background as the page, NO cards, NO white strip, NO pill, NO border around a row.
Child 1: journal outline icon, "Nhật ký sức khỏe", small right chevron.
Child 2: bookmark outline icon, "Bản tin sức khỏe", native teal enabled switch aligned right.
Child 3: flag outline icon, "Nhiệm vụ", small right chevron.
Continue parent rows at the ORIGINAL unindented alignment:
"Tài khoản" collapsed, down chevron.
"Cài đặt" collapsed, down chevron.
"Hệ thống" collapsed, down chevron.
Then a simple red icon + "Đăng xuất" text action.
No big "Cá nhân" page heading and no management subtitle, no inspirational footer slogan. No personal-info data cards visible because that section is collapsed.
Bottom white tab navigation bar with four tabs "Trang chủ", "Kết nối", "Tổng quan", "Cá nhân"; only "Cá nhân" active in teal. Status bar and home indicator appropriate for iOS.
Spacing: clean consistent 20pt screen padding; parent tap rows at least 56pt and child tap rows at least 52–56pt. Modest comfortable text sizes, enough space to read the whole shown menu, clearly aligned right-side switches and chevrons.
Style: restrained teal healthcare app, calm and practical, natural native UI, very crisp Vietnamese text and icons. No card shadows on menu items, no glowing gradients, no repeated decorative icons, no extra text. Preserve correct Vietnamese diacritics. The inset child alignment is essential.
